verdicts.flaw_description: "The counts cover the sessions that reached the new page, and a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout." The measured population is restricted to sessions that made it to the new checkout page, while a quarter of each segment is excluded because it dropped out before checkout. Purchases are therefore computed over a self-selected, higher-intent remainder rather than over all sessions; if the new page shifts who survives to that point, the 4-7 percent lift can be composition rather than any effect of the page. Every other stated safeguard (prices matched to the cent, same general catalogue) is irrelevant to this exclusion.

"The figures cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service, and a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed." A quarter of runs are dropped from the figures, and bypassing is not random - filters are typically bypassed during upsets or heavy/dirty operation, so the excluded runs are plausibly the highest-particulate ones and the retained set is biased low. Compounding this, "Throughput at each site fell by half against the earlier quarter" while the offered immunizer only guarantees firing hours were unchanged ("a fixed duty cycle, the same hours whatever the throughput"); constant firing hours does not block throughput from driving particulate load, so halved throughput alone could produce the 8-14 percent drop.

"Averages cover the patients who kept up the home exercises, and a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse." The abduction averages are computed only over the adherent patients, dropping the quarter who lapsed. Adherence is post-treatment and strongly correlated with prognosis, motivation and pain level, so the compliant remainder would show better range of motion than the full intake regardless of the protocol; the home exercises themselves are also an uncontrolled co-intervention. The 9-16 degree gains cannot be attributed to the protocol.

"Rates cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat, and about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed." Germination is scored only on trays whose seed took a full coat, excluding the fifth sown from partly coated seed. Seed that takes a full coat is plausibly the plumper, better-filled, more viable seed, so the retained trays are selected on a seed-quality variable that itself predicts germination; the 6-11 point gain over the previous spring sowing could come from that selection rather than the coating.

"Rates cover the boards soldered on the new profile throughout, and about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile." The defect rates are computed only over boards run entirely on the new profile; roughly a tenth of each run is dropped. The earlier-period comparison presumably included all boards, so the two figures are not computed over comparable populations, and if the excluded mixed-pass boards are the reworked or problem boards, the exclusion mechanically lowers the measured defect rate independently of the profile.
